purpose: One exact SE flash, one 150k/30s DATA1024 trial, then only if successful two 50k/100k five-second regressions. Each diagnostic trial starts after a fresh boot and actual user USB replug. No analogue or indefinite stability claim.
before_flash: Exact production/native/ARM/sourceGUI review has no open P0/P1 and score>=9.5; source commit clean for Windows package.
Record and verify exact Windows package and independent package review; physical assertions remain unverified.
Check one expected ST-Link, COM6 identity, application closed and no capture owner. Board powered only by its USB; PA0 empty; ST-Link supply disconnected per user.
Read fresh 64KiB current SD backup without erasing; require known 39448-byte SD prefix. Preserve earlier backups.
Final plan pins helpers, exact image, backup and package; independent exact-plan admission required before Flash.
flash_procedure: Program pinned candidate at0x08000000 with ST-Link verification; log exact argv, exit code, expected probe SN and Verification...OK/Programming Complete.
Independent Dump of all42444bytes must equal candidate byte-for-byte before reset.
Reset/Run once; success strings MCU Reset. and Application started.; do not infer failure from absence of running.
Ask actual new USB-board unplug/replug; leave ST-Link unchanged, PA0 empty, app closed. Wait for user reply before START.
session_rules: Only one START per session; discovery0.2 cap15/max1024/payload1300, fresh nonce selected HELLO0.3, exact build/CAPS before START.
Use existing v2_stream_probe.py with selected Fs, source commit, image SHA and new run folder; preserve wire and raw. Preview then Record then explicit Stop and fresh Open.
Never SWD/halt during active owner. Confirm owner closure and complete normal END/STOP_ACK before diagnostic reads; queuefull fault may use separately guarded fault reader after matching END/ACK.
Offline analysis must verify indices, sequence, canonical CRC, full1024 plus optional final short, no DATA after short, file/raw equality and unknown produced tail.
Read136 twice at exact nm address, then TIM3 0x40000400/48, ADC0x40012408/12, DMA0x40020008/16, RCC0x4002100C/20. Never read ADC_DR.
Require fresh build/nonce/generation, flags0, ADCpoll/copy below selected deadline and stopped timer/ADC/DMA with expected PSC/ARR. Root records actual chronology separately.
Proceed to next Fs only after all previous gates pass. New Reset/Run plus actual new user USB replug is mandatory to reset one-attempt-per-boot diagnostic; never reuse prior reply.

On any failure preserve all evidence and stop this trial plan. Do not repeat START or restore SD automatically. Concrete boot/link/stop problem requires root assessment; throughput failure alone does not justify rollback.
